Venezuela Unblocks News Websites Amid Resumed Talks

Venezuela has unblocked access to some news websites that had been censored for years, according to its telecom regulator. The move coincides with the scheduled resumption of US-backed political transition talks. Digital rights group VE Sin Filtro confirmed that 17 news sites are now accessible through several internet providers. However, the group also reported that at least 188 websites remain blocked.
